Review: BUG-1500

REQUEST_CHANGES at rebased head 9ba1acca65. The lib.rs helper is correct, but git_backend_cmd.rs still unconditionally says the orphan store may be mid-rebase and advises git rebase --abort. Fix the second emission site, add both-state tests, inspect other unchecked recovery hints, push a new head, and leave the spec in progress.
